Battle tale of undaunted Liberation War hero Amin Hemrom
2021-12-20T23:06:01+06:00 | Star Special
https://www.thedailystar.net/star-multimedia/news-multimedia/news/battle-tale-undaunted-liberation-war-hero-amin-hemrom-2921951

Amin Hemrom, a valiant Santal freedom fighter, specialised in guerilla warfare, fought at the frontlines during the Liberation War at the age of 26.

Under the command of Commander Abdus Samad, he, along with other liberation heroes, got hold of Argara Haat in Shibganj, keeping it unoccupied by the enemy until September.

In this glorious 50 years of independence, Star Special presents the brave battle tale of Amin Hemrom.
